init_distributed_mode: init distributed PyTorch mode for single GPU, multi-GPU, or SLURM cluster jobs
average_metrics: average a dictionary of metrics across all distributed workers with optional weighting
setup_logging_for_distributed: setup rank-aware logging that only prints from the master process in distributed mode
all_reduce: perform an all-reduce operation on a tensor across all distributed processes
save_on_master: save a torch tensor or object only from the main process in distributed training
